name: may-move-policy-v1
question: Does the frozen compact searched evaluator select stronger legal moves than static compact evaluation?

selection.method: Seeded reservoir sample over the complete decompressed monthly stream.

development.coefficient_data: Deduplicated January/February union with repeated targets averaged
development.implementation_domain: April may be used for code development but not confirmation
development.overlap_exclusion: All position hashes observed in January through April

confirmation_oracle.root_ranking: Stockfish 18 depth 12, MultiPV 3, Threads 1, Hash 16 MB
confirmation_oracle.chosen_move_value: Root-move-constrained depth-12 analysis with the same engine options

policies.locked-3: Enumerate every legal root move and statically evaluate its child position
policies.full-16: Enumerate every legal root move and statically evaluate its child position
policies.searched-3: Enumerate every legal root move, then apply frozen two-ply forcing search to each child position

forcing_search.rules: Identical forcing vocabulary, ordering, stand-pat, and terminal values to march-compact-rules-v1

reported_metrics: mean, median, p95, and maximum centipawn regret
root moves evaluated, forcing expansions, and latency
primary_test: searched-3 minus locked-3 mean clipped centipawn regret
advance_rule: 100% legal coverage and a negative paired mean difference whose 95% source-game bootstrap interval excludes zero.
secondary_test: searched-3 minus full-16 mean clipped centipawn regret
